component.name: PlaylistGuide

Label.text: Choose a program to play Back: return to channels

component.script:
sub init() m.heading = m.top.findNode("heading") m.itemGrid = m.top.findNode("itemGrid") m.guideBackdrop = m.top.findNode("guideBackdrop") m.guideBackdrop.opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_backdrop_opacity", 0.25) m.top.findNode("guideForeground").opacity = manifestOpacity("guide_foreground_opacity", 1.0) m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("channelTitle", "onChannelTitleChanged") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "focusGuide") m.itemGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected") m.itemGrid.observeField("itemFocused", "onItemFocused") end sub
sub onContentChanged() m.itemGrid.content = m.top.content updateBackdrop(0) end sub
sub onChannelTitleChanged() m.heading.text = m.top.channelTitle + " Programs" end sub
sub onItemSelected(event as object) position = event.getData() if type(position) = "roArray" m.top.itemSelected = position[0] * m.itemGrid.numColumns + position[1] else m.top.itemSelected = position end if end sub
sub onItemFocused(event as object) position = event.getData() if type(position) = "roArray" index = position[0] * m.itemGrid.numColumns + position[1] else index = position end if updateBackdrop(index) end sub
sub updateBackdrop(index as integer) if m.top.content = invalid or index < 0 or index >= m.top.content.getChildCount() m.guideBackdrop.visible = false m.guideBackdrop.uri = "" return end if item = m.top.content.getChild(index) if item = invalid or item.HDPosterUrl = "" m.guideBackdrop.visible = false m.guideBackdrop.uri = "" return end if m.guideBackdrop.uri = item.HDPosterUrl m.guideBackdrop.visible = true end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
sub focusGuide() m.itemGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" m.top.closeRequested = true return true end if if key = "left" m.top.menuRequested = true return true end if return false end function
